# CittaSL (CSL) - Enterprise Software & Regulatory Middleware

> CittaSL (CSL) is an enterprise software engineering firm and technology member of CittaNuvola Group. CSL specializes in non-intrusive regulatory fiscal middleware (CittaEFS), enterprise transaction routing (CittaMatrix), resource planning (CittaPlannerX), API gateway infrastructure (CittaNexus), and industry-specific ERP software.

## Primary Products & Solutions

### 1. CittaEFS (Electronic Fiscal Middleware)
- **Category:** Regulatory Fiscal Middleware & Tax Pre-Clearance
- **Function:** Intercepts invoice payloads from ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Dynamics, custom software) before ledger commitment, validates tax logic (such as Nigerian VAT 7.5%, withholding tax, withholding certificates), and securely transmits compliant data to National Revenue Service (NRS) and statutory tax portals.
- **Key Feature:** Non-intrusive database trigger integration without requiring core ERP refactoring.

### 2. CittaMatrix (Enterprise Transaction Router)
- **Category:** Transaction Processing & Multi-Ledger Synchronization
- **Function:** Real-time multi-entity transaction routing engine and payment clearing middleware for corporate groups and financial institutions.

### 3. CittaPlannerX (Resource Allocation & Project Logistics)
- **Category:** Enterprise Resource Planning & Project Logistics
- **Function:** Intelligent critical path analysis, resource capacity leveling, and multi-site project scheduling software for heavy construction, logistics, and engineering operations.

### 4. CittaNexus (API Gateway & Integration Mesh)
- **Category:** Enterprise Middleware & Security Gateway
- **Function:** Ultra-low-latency API gateway featuring cryptographic data hashing, token vault management, and circuit breaker protection for sensitive corporate data flows.

### 5. CittaHospitalityX (Property Management System)
- **Category:** Hospitality & Property Management Software
- **Function:** Real-time channel manager, folio billing, front-desk management, and multi-property management system for luxury hotels, resorts, and vacation rentals.

## Technical & Integration Highlights
- **ERP Compatibility:** Seamlessly integrates with SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, Odoo ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and custom SQL databases.
- **Compliance:** 100% compliant with National Revenue Service (NRS), Tax Compliance Council, and state fiscal authority guidelines.
- **Security Standard:** Cryptographically stamped data envelopes, AES-256-GCM encryption, and SOC2-ready architecture.
